tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text:
Match the column I with column II and mark the appropriate choice.

Column I Column II
(p) 3d-transition series (i) Z = 58 to Z = 71
(q) Lanthanoid series (ii) Z = 39 to Z = 48
(r) Actinoid series (iii) Z = 21 to Z = 30
(s) 4d-transition series (iv) Z = 90 to Z = 103

solution.text:
Column I Column II
(p) 3d-transition series (iii) Z = 21 to Z = 30 (Zn)
(q) Lanthanoid series (i) Z = 58 to Z = 71 (Lu)
(r) Actinoid series (iv) Z = 90 to Z = 103 (Lr)
(s) 4d-transition series (ii) Z = 39 to Z = 48 (Cd)
